name: 重庆大学
character: Located by the Jialing River, the main campus features an artificial lake alongside traditional Chinese-style Republican-era buildings, Soviet-style neoclassical halls, and a 27-story modern teaching building.

landmarks.name: 民主湖
landmarks.quote: 民主湖——位于重庆大学A校区的人工湖
landmarks.look: An artificial campus lake with a memorial stone and lecture hall nearby.

landmarks.name: 大校门
landmarks.quote: 中央大学大礼堂、大校门、老图书馆楼入选“20世纪建筑遗产名录”

landmarks.name: 老图书馆楼
landmarks.quote: 大校门、老图书馆楼入选“20世纪建筑遗产名录”和“优秀近代建筑名录”。
landmarks.look: A historic early-20th-century brick-and-tile library building.

landmarks.name: 原理学院楼（第一教学楼）
landmarks.name_en: Former Science College Building (First Teaching Building)
landmarks.quote: 原理学院楼（第一教学楼）——建于1932年，由重庆大学创办人之一沈懋德设计，为砖木混合结构。
landmarks.look: A 1932 brick-and-wood building with traditional upturned eaves and red pillars.

landmarks.name: 原工学院楼（第二教学楼）
landmarks.name_en: Former Engineering College Building (Second Teaching Building)
landmarks.quote: 原工学院楼（第二教学楼）——建于1935年，由留法学者刁泰干设计
landmarks.look: A 1935 Republican-era academic hall with a bombing memorial monument nearby.

landmarks.name: 中央大学大礼堂
landmarks.quote: 中央大学大礼堂、大校门、老图书馆楼入选“20世纪建筑遗产名录”

landmarks.name: 寅初亭
landmarks.quote: 寅初亭——为纪念曾任重庆大学商学院院长的马寅初先生而建。

landmarks.name: 主教学楼
landmarks.quote: 主教学楼——建于2005年，楼高27层，地下3层，是重大本部A区最现代化的建筑
